title: Trump blasts Germany over gas pipeline deal with Russia
summary: A CBS Evening News report from the 2018 NATO summit, where President Trump criticized Germany over its gas pipeline deal with Russia and pressed allies on defense spending.
why: Linked as the famous clip of Trump scolding Germany over Russian gas, whenever European energy dependence comes up.
